Vulcan Forged operates on the Binance Smart Chain.

LCX is a token issued on the Ethereum blockchain as an ERC-20 token. LCX is associated with a company based in Liechtenstein. LCX operates as a regulated exchange and tokenization platform rather than a fully permissionless protocol.

Cheese Bank operates on the Binance Smart Chain. Cheese Bank was exploited in November 2021 through a flash loan attack.

PancakeBunny operates on the Binance Smart Chain. PancakeBunny is a yield farming protocol built on top of PancakeSwap. PancakeBunny was exploited in May 2021 through manipulation of the price of its BUNNY token.

Vesper Finance operates on the Ethereum blockchain. Vesper Finance provides yield vaults that automatically compound returns for depositors. Vesper Finance issues the VSP governance token.
